verdict.rationale: Supabase Storage is documented for managing files of any size. It supports uploads over S3-compatible, REST and TUS resumable protocols. Access is controlled by row-level security and custom policies, and assets are served from a global CDN in over 285 cities, with on-the-fly image transformations as an extra. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of storage access rules or CDN delivery; the evidence is vendor docs only.
